name: claude-skills-journalism
description: Agent skills and Claude Code plugins for journalism, research, and media organizations

plugins.name: autocontext
plugins.description: Accumulates project knowledge across sessions and developers through structured lessons and hooks

plugins.name: dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Thirteen development skills for newsroom and research dev teams: accessibility, context management, directed multi-agent execution, Electron, mobile debugging, Python pipelines, test-first bug fixing, ethical scraping, no-build frontends, web UI craft, and CLAUDE.md maintenance.

plugins.name: journalism-core
plugins.description: Fifteen core journalism skills for reporting, verification, publishing, and digital investigations: AP-style writing, AI-slop detox, source verification, FOIA/OPRA and Brazilian LAI requests, fact-checking, interview prep and transcription, story pitches, editorial workflow, crisis comms, newsletter publishing, data journalism, social-media OSINT, and embedded photo metadata.

plugins.name: okf-wiki
plugins.description: Scaffold an Open Knowledge Format (OKF) knowledge base from docs, plans, notes, or a repo: one-concept-per-file Markdown with YAML frontmatter, navigation, and validation. Built for newsroom memory, research atlases, decision logs, and infrastructure maps.

plugins.name: pdf-design
plugins.description: PDF report and proposal design system with interactive editing

plugins.name: pdf-playground
plugins.description: Interactive playground for creating and testing PDF reports and proposals

plugins.name: project-templates-toolkit
plugins.description: Three skills for starting and closing out journalism projects: a CLAUDE.md project-memory writer, a LESSONS.md retrospective writer, and a template-selector decision tree for editorial tools, events, publications, research, pipelines, and archives.

plugins.name: research-toolkit
plugins.description: Six skills for research, source preservation, and academic workflows: academic writing, legal paywall bypass (Unpaywall, library databases), web archiving (Wayback, Archive.today, ArchiveBox), page-change monitoring, AI-enriched digital archives, and a curated free-API catalog.

plugins.name: security-toolkit
plugins.description: Four defensive security skills covering OWASP Top 10 and supply-chain hardening: pre-deployment audit checklists, secure authentication (hashing, sessions, JWT, OAuth, passkeys), API hardening (rate limiting, CORS, throttling), and npm/bun install-time cooldown with a sandboxed bypass scan.

plugins.name: superjawn
plugins.description: Research-augmented fork of obra/superpowers. Ships all 14 workflow skills (brainstorming, planning, TDD, code review, debugging, worktrees, parallel agents) standalone, with no dependency on the upstream superpowers plugin.

plugins.name: video-toolkit
plugins.description: Four composable skills for social-video accountability reporting: downloading public video from X, TikTok, YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook, transcribing it with a provenance record, extracting and vision-analyzing frames, and building an interactive dashboard.

plugins.name: visual-explainer
plugins.description: HTML diagrams, data tables, and architecture views adapted from nicobailon/visual-explainer with newsroom and academic design sensibilities. Generates self-contained pages with Mermaid diagrams, KPI cards, slide decks, and zoom/pan controls.
